cards.name: Windows Virtual Machine
cards.az900ExamTip: IaaS compute providing full operating system control and legacy application compatibility
cards.description: Windows-based virtual machine with dedicated compute and customizable OS configuration

cards.name: Linux Virtual Machine
cards.az900ExamTip: Cost-effective IaaS compute supporting Ubuntu, Red Hat, SUSE, and other Linux distributions
cards.description: Linux-based virtual machine for open-source stacks, web servers, and container hosts

cards.name: Virtual Machine Scale Sets
cards.az900ExamTip: VMSS deploys and manages identical load-balanced VMs with automatic horizontal scaling
cards.description: Automated group of load-balanced VMs that scale up or down based on metrics or schedule

cards.name: Azure App Service
cards.az900ExamTip: PaaS for web apps and REST APIs with built-in auto-scaling, SSL, and zero-downtime deployment slots
cards.description: Fully managed platform for building, hosting, and auto-scaling modern web applications

cards.name: Azure Functions
cards.az900ExamTip: Serverless compute that runs code in response to events with pay-per-execution consumption billing
cards.description: Event-driven serverless compute platform executing micro-logic without dedicated servers

cards.name: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
cards.az900ExamTip: Managed Kubernetes orchestrator with free cluster management plane and integrated Azure identity
cards.description: Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform for complex microservices topologies

cards.name: Azure Container Instances (ACI)
cards.az900ExamTip: Run containers without managing servers or orchestrators; fastest way to launch isolated containers
cards.description: Serverless container execution without VM provisioning or cluster setup overhead

cards.name: Azure Virtual Desktop
cards.az900ExamTip: Cloud-based desktop and app virtualization supporting multi-session Windows 10/11
cards.description: Secure remote desktop infrastructure accessible anywhere with central access control

cards.name: Azure Blob Storage
cards.az900ExamTip: Object storage optimized for massive amounts of unstructured data like images, logs, and backups
cards.description: Highly scalable object store supporting Hot, Cool, Cold, and Archive storage tiers

cards.name: Azure Files
cards.az900ExamTip: Fully managed file shares accessible via industry-standard SMB or NFS protocols
cards.description: Cloud file shares that can be mounted simultaneously by on-premise and cloud VMs

cards.name: Azure Managed Disks
cards.az900ExamTip: Block-level storage volumes attached to Azure VMs (Standard HDD, Standard SSD, Premium SSD, Ultra)
cards.description: Durable block storage for VMs with 99.999% availability and host-level caching

cards.name: Blob Storage Archive Tier
cards.az900ExamTip: Lowest cost storage tier for rarely accessed data with hours of retrieval latency
cards.description: Cost-optimized cold data retention tier designed for multi-year regulatory compliance archives

cards.name: Azure Virtual Network (VNet)
cards.az900ExamTip: Fundamental building block for private networking in Azure; isolates cloud resources securely
cards.description: Private network perimeter providing IP address allocation, subnets, and traffic routing

cards.name: Azure VPN Gateway
cards.az900ExamTip: Sends encrypted traffic between Azure VNet and on-premises datacenter over the public Internet
cards.description: Site-to-site and point-to-site encrypted tunneling gateway connecting hybrid locations

cards.name: Azure ExpressRoute
cards.az900ExamTip: Private dedicated connection to Azure that does NOT travel over the public Internet
cards.description: High-throughput private connectivity with lower latency, higher reliability, and SLA guarantees

cards.name: Network Security Group (NSG)
cards.az900ExamTip: Filters network traffic to and from Azure resources in a VNet using 5-tuple security rules
cards.description: Stateful packet filtering rules based on source/dest IP, port, and protocol

cards.name: Azure Firewall
cards.az900ExamTip: Cloud-native stateful firewall-as-a-service with built-in high availability and unrestricted scalability
cards.description: Centralized network traffic inspection and threat intelligence filtering across VNets

cards.name: Azure DNS
cards.az900ExamTip: Host DNS domains in Azure using global anycast name servers for ultra-fast query resolution
cards.description: Reliable and secure DNS hosting service using Microsoft global network infrastructure

cards.name: Azure Load Balancer
cards.az900ExamTip: Layer 4 (TCP/UDP) ultra-low latency load balancer that distributes traffic across healthy VMs
cards.description: High-performance non-HTTP traffic distribution across backend VM pools

cards.name: Azure Application Gateway
cards.az900ExamTip: Layer 7 web traffic load balancer with Web Application Firewall (WAF), SSL termination, and URL routing
cards.description: Advanced HTTP/HTTPS application delivery controller with integrated OWASP rule protection

cards.name: Azure SQL Database
cards.az900ExamTip: Fully managed relational database engine with automated backups, patching, and 99.995% SLA
cards.description: Intelligent DBaaS powered by the SQL Server engine with built-in threat detection and tuning

cards.name: Azure SQL Managed Instance
cards.az900ExamTip: Near 100% compatibility with on-prem SQL Server, ideal for lift-and-shift database migration
cards.description: Full-featured SQL Server instance hosted in a dedicated VNet subnet with native DB mail and CLR

cards.name: Azure Cosmos DB
cards.az900ExamTip: Globally distributed multi-model NoSQL database offering single-digit millisecond latency SLAs
cards.description: Turnkey global distribution with multi-region active-active writes and flexible consistency models

cards.name: Azure Database Migration Service
cards.az900ExamTip: Assists seamless offline or online database migration from on-prem SQL/Oracle to Azure databases
cards.description: Automated workflow service for minimal downtime database schema and data migration

cards.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
cards.az900ExamTip: Enterprise analytics service unifying data integration, enterprise data warehousing, and big data
cards.description: Limitless analytics platform combining SQL data warehouses with Apache Spark engines

cards.name: Azure Event Hubs
cards.az900ExamTip: Big data streaming platform and event ingestion service capable of processing millions of events/sec
cards.description: High-throughput real-time telemetry streaming buffer for IoT and operational monitoring
